# packages
```{r}
library(rlang)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(gtools)
library(stringr)

### files you need: ###
#  dda_bwa_htseq_a1_ercc_only # Hemiaulus intermediate data product ercc tpms only file, available on Zenodo
#  ercc_stds # ercc concentrations per sample, from Zenodo
#  cell_counts_final_tp.csv # cell counts for hemiaulus and richelia heterocysts, made from Table S1
#  rich_bwa_htseq_a1_tpm_ercc_only # Richelia intermediate data product ercc tpms only file, available on Zenodo
```

# make formula table
```{r}
# read in ERCC raw counts for hemiaulus and richelia files 
dda_htseq_a1_ercc_only <- read.csv("dda_bwa_htseq_a1_ercc_only")

# calculate coverage
cov_ercc <- lapply(dda_htseq_a1_ercc_only, function(x){ length(which(x>0))/length(x)}) 

# number of non-zero hits divided by total length-- ranges from 88-97%, avg 92%
cov_ercc_stats <- cov_ercc %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(-c(1,4,14)) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  summarise(min(V1),max(V1),mean(V1))

# read in ERCC file with concentrations and # molecules per standards added- get formula table for each sample
# this tabel is available on Zenodo
ercc_stds <- read.csv("ERCC_calcs_for_R.csv", header=T)

# join ercc concentrations with ercc tpms for all samples (from htseq a1)
ercc_calcs <- dda_htseq_a1_ercc_only %>%
  dplyr::select(-14) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ERCC.ID = "Contig_ID") %>%
  right_join(ercc_stds, by = "ERCC.ID") %>%
  mutate(dplyr::across(c(2:13,19:20),function(x) log2(x))) %>%  #log2 transform columns
  rename_with( .fn = function(.x){paste0(.x, "_log")}, .cols=c(2:13,19:20)) #add _log to end of transformed columns
  
ercc_calcs[sapply(ercc_calcs, is.infinite)] <- NA

# need to plot each sample, get equation
## if refed or replete then 1:10; if deplete then 1:100

# function to pull linear regression equation from each comparison
make_lm_formula_table <- function(df, outcome, predictors) {
  
  results <- data.frame(
    sample    = character(),
    predictor = character(),
    intercept = numeric(),
    slope     = numeric(),
    r2        = numeric(),
    formula   = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for (out in outcome) {
    ## conditional for predictors
    if (grepl("replete|refed", out, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      pred <- predictor_rep
    } else {
      pred <- predictor_dep
    }
    
    ## clean data
    clean_df <- df[
      !is.infinite(df[[out]]) & !is.na(df[[out]]) &
      !is.infinite(df[[pred]]) & !is.na(df[[pred]]),
    ]
    
    ## Skip if insufficient data
    if (nrow(clean_df) < 2) {
      warning(paste("Skipping", out, "- not enough clean data"))
      next
    }
    
    ## linear model
    model <- lm(clean_df[[out]] ~ clean_df[[pred]])
    coeffs <- coef(model)
    
    intercept <- coeffs[1]
    slope <- coeffs[2]
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    ## fix string fro formula
    formula_str <- paste0(
      out, " = ",
      round(intercept, 4), " + ",
      round(slope, 4), " * ", pred
    )
    
    ## add rows in sequence
    results <- rbind(
      results,
      data.frame(
        sample    = out,
        predictor = pred,
        intercept = intercept,
        slope     = slope,
        r2        = r2,
        formula   = formula_str,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }
  
  return(results)
}

## define outcome and predictor columns
outcome <- c("Deplete_1_R1_TPM_log","Deplete_1_R2_TPM_log","Deplete_1_R3_TPM_log","Replete_1_R1_TPM_log","Replete_1_R2_TPM_log","Replete_1_R3_TPM_log",
                "Refed_2_R1_TPM_log" ,"Refed_2_R2_TPM_log","Refed_2_R3_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R1_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R2_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R3_TPM_log")
predictor_dep <- c("molecules_ERCC_transcript_for_1_100_dil_log")
predictor_rep <- c("molecules_ERCC_transcript_for_1_10_dil_log" )

## run function
formula_table <- make_lm_formula_table(ercc_calcs, outcome = outcome, predictors = predictors)

print(formula_table)

```

### calculating molecules/contig for all contigs (from tpm data)
# take formula table from above chunk and tpms for dda samples and get molecule # of transcripts for hemiaulus
```{r}
## dda counts
dda_bwa_htseq_a1_hemi <- dda_bwa_htseq_a1 %>%
  full_join(hemi_contigs_only, by = "Contig_ID") %>% 
  mutate(Taxa = if_else(grepl("ERCC", Contig_ID), "ERCC", Taxa)) %>%
  filter(Taxa == "Hemiaulus") # remove richelia

## convert to tpm
dda_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm <- dda_bwa_htseq_a1_hemi %>%
  dplyr::select(-14) %>%
  mutate(dplyr::across(c(2:13),function(x) x/sum(x)*1000000)) %>%  #TPM:normalize by sum of each column divided by 1M
  rename_with( .fn = function(.x){paste0(.x, "_TPM")}, .cols=c(2:13)) #add _TPM to end of transformed columns

## convert to molecules using ercc formulas derived above
formula_tbl <- formula_table %>%
  mutate(sample = str_sub(sample, 1, -5)) %>% #remove _tpm from the end of the strings in each row
  remove_rownames() 

dda_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log <- dda_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm %>%
  remove_rownames() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Contig_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(1:12, ~ pmin(log2(.x)))) #log transform tpms

dda_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log[sapply(dda_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log, is.infinite)] <- NA

dda_tpm_formula_working <- dda_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(formula_tbl, by = "sample")

## extract expression matrix
expr_mat <- dda_tpm_formula_working %>%
  select(-sample, -predictor, -intercept, -slope, -r2, -formula) %>%
  as.matrix()

## extract parameters
intercepts <- dda_tpm_formula_working$intercept
slopes     <- dda_tpm_formula_working$slope

## apply transformation
expr_transformed <- sweep(expr_mat, 1, intercepts, FUN = "-")
expr_transformed <- sweep(expr_transformed, 1, slopes, FUN = "/")

## return to original form
dda_tpm_formula <- expr_transformed %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

## define outcomes
outcome <- c("Deplete_1_R1_TPM_log","Deplete_1_R2_TPM_log","Deplete_1_R3_TPM_log","Replete_1_R1_TPM_log","Replete_1_R2_TPM_log","Replete_1_R3_TPM_log", "Refed_2_R1_TPM_log" ,"Refed_2_R2_TPM_log","Refed_2_R3_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R1_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R2_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R3_TPM_log")

colnames(dda_tpm_formula) = outcome

## make sure log values print
max_val <- .Machine$double.xmax

## extra formatting
dda_tpm_formula_molecules_numeric <- dda_tpm_formula %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric)

## log transformation
dda_tpm_formula_molecules <- dda_tpm_formula_molecules_numeric %>%
  mutate(across(1:12, ~ pmin(2^.x, max_val))) %>%
  select(-3) %>% #remove sample that didn't have ercc standards in it
  rename_with(~ str_sub(., 1, -9)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_molecules"), .cols = 1:11)

```

# calculate molecules transcripts per cell
```{r}
## read in molecule df
dda_molecules_contigs <- dda_tpm_formula_molecules %>%
  rownames_to_column("Contig_ID") %>%
  select(1) #isolate the contigs as they get lost in the formula function below
  
dda_tpm_formula_molecules <- dda_tpm_formula_molecules %>%
  rownames_to_column("Contig_ID")

# this is a df made from final timepoint cell counts, made from Table S1. 
# each column is a sample and one row is Hemiaulus and the second is Richelia heterocysts. 
cell_counts <- read.csv("cell_counts_final_tp.csv", header=T)

## divide by cell counts
cell_counts_hemi <- cell_counts %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename_with( .fn = function(.x){paste0(.x, "_molecules")}, .cols=c(2:12)) %>% #add _molecules to end of transformed columns
  filter(X == "Hemiaulus_cells_mL") %>%
  select(-1)

dda_tpm_formula_molecules_no_contig_ID_col <- dda_tpm_formula_molecules %>%
  column_to_rownames("Contig_ID")

## divide by total mL filtered when harvested
mL_filtered <- c(250,250,150,150,150,250,250,250,250,250,250)

mL_filtered <- mL_filtered %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()
  
colnames(mL_filtered) <- colnames(dda_tpm_formula_molecules_no_contig_ID_col)

dda_hemiaulus_molecules_per_mL <- dda_tpm_formula_molecules %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(colnames(mL_filtered)), ~ .x / mL_filtered[[cur_column()]]))

## hemiaulus molecules / cell
dda_hemiaulus_molecules_per_mL_per_cell <- dda_hemiaulus_molecules_per_mL %>%
  arrange(Contig_ID) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Contig_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(colnames(cell_counts_hemi)), ~ .x / cell_counts_hemi[[cur_column()]])) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Contig_ID")
          
```

# take formula table from above chunk and tpms for dda samples and get molecule # of transcripts for richelia
```{r}
## make them tpms and then convert to molecules using ercc formulas derived above
rich_bwa_htseq_a1_tpm <- rich_bwa_htseq_a1_rich_only %>%
  mutate(dplyr::across(c(2:13),function(x) x/sum(x)*1000000)) %>%  #TPM:normalize by sum of each column divided by 1M
  rename_with( .fn = function(.x){paste0(.x, "_TPM")}, .cols=c(2:13)) #add _TPM to end of transformed columns

formula_tbl_richelia <- formula_table_richelia %>%
  mutate(sample = str_sub(sample, 1, -5)) %>% #remove _tpm from the end 
  remove_rownames() 

rich_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log <- rich_bwa_htseq_a1_tpm %>%
  remove_rownames() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Contig_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(1:12, ~ pmin(log2(.x)))) #log transform tpms

rich_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log[sapply(rich_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log, is.infinite)] <- NA

rich_tpm_formula_working <- rich_htseq_a1_hemi_tpm_log %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(formula_tbl_richelia, by = "sample")

## extract expression matrix
expr_mat_rich <- rich_tpm_formula_working %>%
  select(-sample, -predictor, -intercept, -slope, -r2, -formula) %>%
  as.matrix()

## extract parameters
intercepts_rich <- rich_tpm_formula_working$intercept
slopes_rich     <- rich_tpm_formula_working$slope

## transform
expr_transformed_rich <- sweep(expr_mat_rich, 1, intercepts_rich, FUN = "-")
expr_transformed_rich <- sweep(expr_transformed_rich, 1, slopes_rich, FUN = "/")

rich_tpm_formula <- expr_transformed_rich %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

outcome <- c("Deplete_1_R1_TPM_log","Deplete_1_R2_TPM_log","Deplete_1_R3_TPM_log","Replete_1_R1_TPM_log","Replete_1_R2_TPM_log","Replete_1_R3_TPM_log", "Refed_2_R1_TPM_log" ,"Refed_2_R2_TPM_log","Refed_2_R3_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R1_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R2_TPM_log","Deplete_2_R3_TPM_log")

colnames(rich_tpm_formula) = outcome

max_val <- .Machine$double.xmax

rich_tpm_formula_molecules_numeric <- rich_tpm_formula %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.numeric) 

richelia_tpm_formula_molecules <- rich_tpm_formula_molecules_numeric %>%
  mutate(across(1:12, ~ pmin(2^.x, max_val))) %>%
  select(-3) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_sub(., 1, -9)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_molecules"), .cols = 1:11) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Contig_ID")

```

# calculate molecules transcripts per cell
```{r}
# this is a df made from final timepoint cell counts, made from Table S1. 
# each column is a sample and one row is Hemiaulus and the second is Richelia heterocysts. 
cell_counts <- read.csv("cell_counts_final_tp.csv", header=T)

cell_counts_rich <- cell_counts %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename_with( .fn = function(.x){paste0(.x, "_molecules")}, .cols=c(2:12)) %>% #add _molecules to end of transformed columns
  filter(X == "Richelia_cells_mL") %>%
  select(-1)

richelia_tpm_formula_molecules_no_contig_ID_col <- richelia_tpm_formula_molecules %>%
  column_to_rownames("Contig_ID")

## divide by total mL filtered when harvested
mL_filtered <- c(250,250,150,150,150,250,250,250,250,250,250)

mL_filtered <- mL_filtered %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()
  
colnames(mL_filtered) <- colnames(richelia_tpm_formula_molecules_no_contig_ID_col)

richelia_molecules_per_mL <- richelia_tpm_formula_molecules %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(colnames(mL_filtered)), ~ .x / mL_filtered[[cur_column()]]))

## richelia molecules / cell
richelia_molecules_per_mL_per_cell <- richelia_molecules_per_mL %>%
  arrange(Contig_ID) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Contig_ID") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(colnames(cell_counts_rich)), ~ .x / cell_counts_rich[[cur_column()]])) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Contig_ID")

```
